exposure: Compliance with Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations for GWG
weight gain less than the IOM recommendations
weight gain higher than the IOM recommendations
Pre-pregnancy weight status (normal weight, overweight, obese)
outcome: Maternal postpartum weight retention at 6 and 18 months
cohort: 56,101 pregnant women in the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study (MoBa) who delivered a singleton live born child at 37-42 weeks gestation
finding: Exceeding IOM GWG recommendations increased the risk of pregnancy complications like hypertension, high birth weight, preeclampsia, emergency cesarean delivery, and postpartum weight retention in both normal weight and overweight women.
mod_finding: Exceeding IOM GWG recommendations increased the risk of emergency cesarean delivery in both normal weight and overweight women.
